required_guards: Monitor checks expiry before reserving budget
Relay checks expiry before permit admission or supplier send
Both paid targets expire strictly before the same UTC-day budget resets
Remove the paid targets immediately after completion or failure; expiry remains a restart-safe fallback
expiry.note: No future-day renewal or recurring paid pilot authorization

source_budget_notes: All channel 11 targets must carry identical source daily budgets
Keep inventory cost_upper_bound=0 and its one-token placeholder allocation
Paid JSON/SSE targets omit cost_upper_bound and share at most four explicit unknown-cost exposures before expiry
The zero integer cost budget does not mean inference is free

candidate_lifecycle.create: Normal authenticated IAM session and owner CreateUpstreamContract API
candidate_lifecycle.probe: Monitor durable reserve -> relay exact target permit -> owner candidate lease -> one supplier send -> independent installed proof -> owner result
candidate_lifecycle.publish: Only after a passing exact revision/source/binding/incident proof within five minutes; CAS expected binding revision and 1-5 percent gray
candidate_lifecycle.first_binding_baseline: Requests outside the first gray selection retain the existing unbound adapter path; quarantine still blocks the affected protocol
candidate_lifecycle.promotion: At least 30 minutes, 100 complete verified attempts, zero failures, and fresh proof; four pilot calls cannot establish this gate

proof_boundary: DeepSeek contract proof validates the parameter-contract pilot only. The installed native settlement parser, canonical charge status, billing algorithm, customer prices and ledgers keep their independent gates.

production_results.promotion: not authorized by four-call evidence alone
